description: This file defines an abstract class KVStoreView that provides a configurable view for iterating over values in a KVStore, including methods for reversing order, setting index, parent, bounds, and limits.

classes.name: KVStoreView
classes.description: An abstract class providing a configurable, iterable view over a KVStore, supporting various configuration methods for iteration behavior.

methods.name: reverse
methods.description: Reverses the order of iteration, toggling between ascending and descending.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Sets the index name for iteration.

methods.name: parent
methods.description: Sets the parent value for iterating over child indices.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Sets the starting value for iteration.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Sets the ending value for iteration.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of elements to retrieve.

methods.name: skip
methods.description: Sets the number of elements to skip at the start.

methods.name: closeableIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator with the current configuration, cast to KVStoreIterator.
